name: Google Drive
restriction: No live tenant validation or live oracle was performed in this build. Constrained pilot requires per-tenant source evidence.
evidence: Drive adapter, shared-drive/group revocation pipeline and Guard policy tests pass locally with synthetic provider responses.

name: Microsoft 365 / SharePoint / OneDrive
restriction: Protect is disabled until an independently verified effective-permission profile exists for the exact tenant, site and library. Shadow/preview only.
evidence: Graph permission parsing, admin-consent and contract tests pass with synthetic responses.

name: Provider permission event ingestion
restriction: A provider wake-up is not authoritative change state; the change feed must still be reconciled.
evidence: Authenticated, tenant-scoped and idempotent event ingestion plus durable Guard event resolution are covered by local integration tests.

name: OIDC / SSO with stable subject mapping
restriction: A live customer IdP discovery/JWKS exchange was not executed in this build.
evidence: JWT/JWKS verification, issuer/audience/tenant checks and explicit source-identity mapping are covered locally.

name: Static HS256 development credentials
restriction: Development / managed integration only; not an enterprise SSO certification.
evidence: HS256 verification requires an explicitly configured issuer, audience and a key of at least 32 bytes.

name: Buffered HTTP request/response route
restriction: Certification is per deployed route; the static registry is not a customer route certificate.
evidence: Reference Gateway enforces Layer 1 before model input and Layer 2 before the HTTP response body or first SSE byte.

name: Buffered SSE compatibility
restriction: Not incremental model streaming. Native token streaming remains unsupported on protected routes.
evidence: The Gateway generates non-streaming content, completes both Guard layers, then emits already-authorized SSE chunks.

name: Native token streaming
restriction: Use buffered SSE compatibility or keep the route outside Protect.
evidence: No protected route emits model tokens before Layer 2 completes.

name: WebSocket response routes
restriction: A WebSocket route must remain outside the protected claim.
evidence: No WebSocket interception or certification path is implemented.

name: Tool / agent side-effect routes
restriction: Requires a separate action-authorization product; do not present it as covered.
evidence: Tool calls and agent actions are outside the RAG output-release boundary.

name: Background worker results
restriction: A background result returned through a certified synchronous route must still carry provenance.
evidence: No outbound worker result path is certified.

name: Authorized cache-hit return path
restriction: Redis integration is tested with an in-memory client; no live Redis/Memcached/SQL customer return path was certified in this build.
evidence: Signed dependency manifests, current principal checks, current authorization revision binding and Layer 2 re-check are covered locally.

name: Authorization-first pgvector retrieval
restriction: The reference backend has not been executed against a live PostgreSQL/pgvector deployment. The Guard scope is bounded; very large tenants require a datastore-side ACL join.
evidence: Scope-predicate SQL, iterative scan settings, bounded overfetch, exact fallback and scope-violation rejection have SQL-shape/algorithm tests.

name: Pluggable scoped vector backend
restriction: The application is responsible for applying the predicate in the datastore, not after global top-k.
evidence: Applications can supply a backend that accepts an explicit allowed-resource predicate and reports candidate counts.

name: Global ANN then ACL post-filter
restriction: Use the authorization-first retriever or an approved scoped adapter.
evidence: Not offered: a global candidate window can starve entitled users or mis-rank authorized matches.

name: No application cache
evidence: Every protected answer is freshly generated and re-authorized at both Guard layers.

name: Redis signed dependency cache
restriction: No live customer Redis deployment or production return path was certified.
evidence: Reference Redis cache with signed manifests, revision binding and fail-closed stale/outage behavior is tested with an in-memory Redis client.

name: Memcached signed dependency cache
restriction: No live Memcached deployment was executed.
evidence: Backend adapter and signed-manifest verification are unit tested.

name: SQL signed dependency cache
restriction: No live customer SQL cache deployment was executed.
evidence: Backend adapter, expiry janitor and signed-manifest verification are unit tested.

name: OpenAI-compatible buffered model transport
restriction: No live model provider credential was spent; model-specific conformance is per deployment.
evidence: Gateway transport, non-streaming generation and Layer 2 release are covered with a local model stub.

name: Native Anthropic transport
restriction: Not live-provider validated in this build.
evidence: Request/response contract tests only.

name: Native Gemini transport
restriction: Not live-provider validated in this build.
evidence: Request/response contract tests only.

name: Direct model call outside the Gateway
restriction: The compatibility scanner reports direct model clients as certification blockers.
evidence: No enforcement is possible on a path that never reaches Guard.

name: Signed JSON evidence reports
restriction: Reports are control-plane observations, not independent certification of the customer deployment.
evidence: Ed25519-signed tenant-scoped reports with tamper, expiry and cross-tenant tests.

name: Offline evidence verifier
evidence: Standalone verifier checks signature, schema, tenant/type/key expectations and expiry.

name: Signed PDF evidence package
restriction: Do not describe a PDF package as available.
evidence: Only signed JSON reports are implemented.

name: Signed authorization revision ledger
restriction: Content snapshot revision is observed as absent (NOT_OBSERVED) rather than fabricated.
evidence: Monotonic revision allocation, chain linkage, signature verification and audit binding are covered locally.

name: Docker Compose deployment
restriction: Containers were not built or deployed in this constrained environment.
evidence: Compose and Dockerfiles are validated statically by repository tests.

name: Kubernetes / Helm deployment
evidence: No chart or operator is shipped.

name: Independent customer / provider certification
restriction: A CERTIFIED_PROFILE or broad-production claim is therefore unavailable.
evidence: No independent customer RAG, live provider tenant or security assessment was completed in this build.

name: AccessProof RAG Security Gateway
restriction: It protects only the documented attested retrieval-manifest route; an opaque RAG or generic model proxy is not automatically protected.
evidence: Adapter registry certification: REFERENCE_IMPLEMENTATION_TESTED. ('attested allow request', 'revoked-resource denial', 'provenance failure', 'zero-byte pre-Layer-2 release')

name: Generic Python RAG
restriction: Requires stable source/resource metadata and a response buffering boundary.
evidence: Adapter registry certification: IMPLEMENTED_AND_TESTED. ('Layer 1 synthetic denial', 'Layer 2 provenance escape', 'Guard fail-closed')

name: Custom TypeScript / Node.js RAG
restriction: Responses must remain buffered until Layer 2 completes; the package is currently distributed privately and is not published to npm.
evidence: Adapter registry certification: IMPLEMENTED_AND_TESTED. ('Layer 1 synthetic denial', 'Layer 2 provenance escape', 'Guard fail-closed')

name: LangChain Python
restriction: The application must pass the authenticated employee token; validate metadata mapping against the deployed LangChain version.
evidence: Adapter registry certification: IMPLEMENTED_NOT_FRAMEWORK_CERTIFIED. ('Real LangChain invocation in customer build', 'metadata mapping diagnostic', 'revocation test')

name: LlamaIndex Python
restriction: The node metadata must contain an authoritative resource id; validate against the deployed LlamaIndex version.
evidence: Adapter registry certification: IMPLEMENTED_NOT_FRAMEWORK_CERTIFIED. ('Real LlamaIndex invocation in customer build', 'node provenance diagnostic', 'revocation test')

name: LangChain TypeScript
restriction: The structural adapter is tested against the contract, but no real LangChain JS release is pinned or certified in this repository.
evidence: Adapter registry certification: IMPLEMENTED_NOT_FRAMEWORK_CERTIFIED. ('Real LangChain JS invocation in customer build', 'metadata mapping diagnostic', 'revocation test')

name: Haystack Python
restriction: Validate the document metadata mapping against the deployed Haystack version.
evidence: Adapter registry certification: IMPLEMENTED_NOT_FRAMEWORK_CERTIFIED. ('Real Haystack invocation in customer build', 'metadata diagnostic', 'revocation test')

name: Generic HTTP target
restriction: Connectivity and evidence parsing alone do not provide Layer 1 enforcement inside a customer RAG.
evidence: Adapter registry certification: CONNECTIVITY_ONLY. ('Retrieval-boundary proof', 'provenance-boundary proof', 'failure-mode test')
